# Synthetic Public Guidance — Section 4 (test fixture, #644)

This file is a SYNTHETIC stand-in for a captured public reference. It exists so
the six-stage chain — scan, manifest, feed, body ledger, attestation, strict
gate — can be exercised offline against a capture whose sha256 is recorded in a
test-only snapshots file. Nothing here quotes any real document, and the
reference id `NOMOS-SYNTH-PUBLIC-001` is registered only inside the test's
temporary register.

## 4.1 Records

A record kept for the example shall carry the date it was made and the person
who made it, both fictitious.

## 4.2 Review

The example review is performed at an interval that the example organisation
defines and records, and nothing here binds any real organisation.

## 4.3 Retention

Example records are retained for an example period and then disposed of in an
example manner, none of which describes a real obligation.
